summary: First component. Four variants (primary/secondary/ghost/danger), three sizes (44/32/24px), pill or rounded, icon-only and full-width forms, transcribed from the approved Buttons sheet. isIconOnly requires aria-label at the type level; isBusy is visual-only and keeps focus where isDisabled does not. Resting ring is an inset ring so focus keeps the outline layer (survives forced-colors). Ships with a typed doc file and compile-time contract tests. Prerequisites landed with it: Tailwind v4 @theme inline emitter (the remaining Phase 1 emitter), React devDependencies, and an @/ path alias so registry items type-check through the same import specifiers a consumer uses.

migration.manual: New item — nothing to migrate. Consumers install with `npx shadcn add @bydiorama/button`; it pulls in the `cn` lib item and expects react and griddy-icons as peers.
